import bpy
exec("
C=bpy.data.collections['Reference_Coast']
oldroofs=[o for o in C.objects if o.name.startswith('Hut_ThatchedCourse')]
groups={}
for o in oldroofs:groups.setdefault(tuple(round(v,4) for v in o.location),[]).append(o)
# Continuous roofs carry slender overlapping bundles, with restrained colour changes.
roof_count=0
for gi,(origin,objs) in enumerate(groups.items()):
    transform=objs[0].matrix_world.copy()
    half=max(abs(v.co.x) for o in objs for v in o.data.vertices)
    depth=max(v.co.y for o in objs for v in o.data.vertices)*2
    phase=gi*.73
    def profile(t,y):
        return 4.095-1.35*t-.11*math.sin(math.pi*t)+.025*math.sin(y*1.9+phase)*t
    new=[]
    for side in [-1,1]:
        n=int(depth/.11)
        # A dark, thin underside prevents gaps between straw bundles.
        vs=[];fs=[]
        for j in range(n+1):
            yy=-depth*.5+j*depth/n
            for k in range(9):
                t=k/8;vs.append((side*half*t,yy,profile(t,yy)-.055))
        for j in range(n):
            for k in range(8):
                a=j*9+k;f=(a,a+1,a+10,a+9)
                fs.append(f if side>0 else tuple(reversed(f)))
        ob=mesh('D19_Hut_RoofUnderlay',vs,fs,M['Straw']);new.append(ob)
        sol=ob.modifiers.new('Roof body','SOLIDIFY');sol.thickness=.045
        for j in range(n):
            yy=-depth*.5+(j+.5)*depth/n
            width=depth/n*.99
            for row in range(3):
                t0=row/3;t1=min(1,(row+1)/3+.055)
                t1+=.012*math.sin(j*2.37+row+phase) if row==2 else .006*math.sin(j*1.63+row)
                verts=[];faces=[]
                for k in range(5):
                    t=t0+(t1-t0)*k/4
                    for across in [-1,0,1]:
                        y_=yy+across*width*.5
                        z=profile(t,y_)+.045*(2-row)+.016*(1-abs(across))+.005*math.sin(j*1.3+phase)
                        if k==4:z-=.018+(.008 if j%4==0 else 0)
                        verts.append((side*half*t,y_,z))
                for k in range(4):
                    for a in range(2):
                        q=k*3+a;f=(q,q+3,q+4,q+1)
                        faces.append(f if side>0 else tuple(reversed(f)))
                ob=mesh('D19_Hut_ThatchBundle',verts,faces,M['Straw']);new.append(ob)
                sol=ob.modifiers.new('Compressed straw','SOLIDIFY');sol.thickness=.035
                for p in ob.data.polygons:p.use_smooth=True
                uv=ob.data.uv_layers.active
                for li,l in enumerate(ob.data.loops):
                    v=ob.data.vertices[l.vertex_index].co
                    uv.data[li].uv=(v.y*1.25+gi*.17,abs(v.x)*.65)
    # Wrapped ridge, subtly arched, replaces the sharp exposed stick.
    pts=[(0,-depth*.5+i*depth/16,4.13+.015*math.sin(i*.6+phase)) for i in range(17)]
    new.append(tube('D19_Hut_ThatchedRidge',pts,.105,M['Straw'],10))
    for yi in range(7):
        yy=-depth*.5+.12+yi*(depth-.24)/6
        new.append(tube('D19_RidgeBinding',[(-.12,yy,4.105),(-.075,yy,4.22),(0,yy,4.255),(.075,yy,4.22),(.12,yy,4.105)],.016,M['Cord'],6))
    apply_group(new,transform);roof_count+=len(new)
for o in oldroofs:bpy.data.objects.remove(o,do_unlink=True)
for o in list(C.objects):
    if o.name.startswith('Hut_RidgeCap'):bpy.data.objects.remove(o,do_unlink=True)
# Infill is supported by a readable lower frame; door hardware and eave rafters have real thickness.
for gi,(origin,objs) in enumerate(groups.items()):
    originv=Vector(origin)
    # Old roof matrices already copied before deletion into the new underlay transforms.
    roof=next(o for o in C.objects if o.name.startswith('D19_Hut_RoofUnderlay') and (o.location-originv).length<.01)
    transform=roof.matrix_world.copy();inv=transform.inverted()
    fronts=[o for o in C.objects if o.name.startswith('Hut_FrontPanel') and (o.location-originv).length<3.2]
    candidates=[o for o in fronts if abs((inv@o.location).y)<2.0]
    if len(candidates)<2:continue
    d=abs((inv@candidates[0].location).y)*2
    w=max(abs((inv@o.location).x)+o.dimensions.x*.5 for o in candidates)*2
    new=[]
    for x_ in [-w*.47,w*.47]:
        new.append(box('D19_Hut_CornerPost',(x_,-d*.51,1.66),(.115,.13,2.06),M['DBeam']))
    new.append(box('D19_Hut_LowerRail',(0,-d*.515,1.04),(w,.085,.09),M['DWood']))
    for x_ in [-.34,.34]:
        for z_ in [1.15,1.85]:
            new.append(box('D19_DoorHinge',(x_,-d*.5-.047,z_),(.15,.025,.065),M['IronDetail'],.006))
    new.append(tube('D19_DoorPull',[(.25,-d*.5-.06,1.50),(.25,-d*.5-.10,1.50),(.25,-d*.5-.10,1.39),(.25,-d*.5-.06,1.39)],.016,M['IronDetail'],8))
    for x_ in [-.32,-.16,0,.16,.32]:
        new.append(box('D19_DoorJoint',(x_,-d*.5-.010,1.27),(.009,.012,1.36),M['DBeam'],0))
    for side in [-1,1]:
        for yy in [-d*.38,0,d*.38]:
            new.append(beam('D19_EaveRafter',(side*w*.32,yy,3.18),(side*(w*.5+.29),yy,2.67),.065,M['DBeam']))
    apply_group(new,transform)
# Piers: individual boards keep their calm colour, but receive slight end wear and fixing points.
pier_boards=[o for o in C.objects if o.name.startswith(('Pier_DeckBoard','Arrival_ApronBoard','Arrival_LeftPierBoard'))]
for i,o in enumerate(pier_boards):
    o.location.z+=.007*math.sin(i*2.17)
    extent=np.array([v.co[:] for v in o.data.vertices]);span=extent.max(0)-extent.min(0)
    long=int(np.argmax(span));short=1-long if long<2 else 0
    for v in o.data.vertices:
        if v.co.z>0 and abs(v.co[long])>span[long]*.49:
            v.co.z-=.005*(.5+.5*math.sin(i+v.index*3))
    new=[]
    for end in [-1,1]:
        p=Vector((0,0,span[2]*.5+.003));p[long]=end*(span[long]*.5-.15)
        new.append(tube('D19_DeckPeg',[p-Vector((0,0,.004)),p+Vector((0,0,.008))],.018,M['IronDetail'],8))
    apply_group(new,o.matrix_world.copy())
# Pile end-grain, discrete knots/tails and brackets at the bearing height.
piles=[o for o in C.objects if o.name.startswith('Pier_Pile') and not o.name.startswith('Pier_PileCap')]
for i,o in enumerate(piles):
    world=[o.matrix_world@v.co for v in o.data.vertices]
    top=max(v.z for v in world);pts=[v for v in world if v.z>top-.05];center=sum(pts,Vector())/len(pts)
    for r in [.045,.085]:
        points=[(center.x+math.cos(t*math.tau/28)*r,center.y+math.sin(t*math.tau/28)*r,top+.058) for t in range(29)]
        tube('D19_PileEndGrain',points,.0025,M['DBeam'],5)
    # Rope tail hangs from a wrap rather than floating beside the pile.
    tube('D19_MooringKnot',[(center.x+.11,center.y,top-.15),(center.x+.19,center.y+.03,top-.17),(center.x+.13,center.y+.06,top-.23),(center.x+.11,center.y,top-.15)],.025,M['Cord'],7)
    tube('D19_RopeTail',[(center.x+.16,center.y+.035,top-.20),(center.x+.19,center.y+.03,top-.35),(center.x+.15,center.y+.015,top-.45)],.021,M['Cord'],7)
    box('D19_PileBracket',(center.x-.015,center.y-.15,.43),(.19,.035,.24),M['IronDetail'],.01)
print('ROOF_AND_JOINERY',roof_count,'new roof pieces;',len(pier_boards),'boards refined')
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=str(ROOT/'source/reference_harbor_mcp.blend'))
",bpy.app.driver_namespace['detail19'])
